concept: A grounded moon-earth sanctuary shaped by strength, comfort, and patient growth.
floor: One continuous smooth jade-green packed-clay floor across the full top face, with broad soft shading and no grass, blades, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One broad low earth shrine at the rear with two abstract outward-curving cream stone buttresses and a large emerald moonstone doorway, suggesting strength without depicting an animal.
rear_props: two large rounded emerald crystal clusters
side_props: two oversized flowering topiary mounds on the upper-left edge
three large jade boulders and one gold lantern on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded moss-jade stone wall with broad cream cap blocks

lighting: soft moon-warm ambient light with restrained antique-gold lantern glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open jade-clay floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, animal, bull head, horns as an animal portrait, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, grass blades, tiny flowers, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
